name: jev-gates
description: Calibrated gates for Claude Code, judged by TypeSafe Jev: a rule guard for edits and a done gate for stops.

scripts.demo:render: asciinema rec --overwrite --window-size 112x32 --command 'npm run demo --silent' demo/out/jev-gates.cast && agg --cols 112 --rows 32 --theme monokai --font-size 16 --idle-time-limit 3 --last-frame-duration 4 demo/out/jev-gates.cast demo/out/jev-gates.gif && ffmpeg -v error -y -i demo/out/jev-gates.gif -movflags faststart -pix_fmt yuv420p -vf 'scale=trunc(iw/2)*2:trunc(ih/2)*2' demo/out/jev-gates.mp4
